$schema_doc: ENGINE-V2 E-3b asymmetric realism gate — locked landings + tight shape bands. Re-locks atomically when E-4 (rating-stature) ships new λ/realism; the gate MECHANISM (strategicAutoDraft + raised N + greedyOverall guard) is the durable infrastructure E-4's realism re-fit measures against.

strategicAutoDraft._doc: PASS-gate measurement target. Slot-fit best-available: for each spin, scan rolled_card_ids and pick max(positionCompatibility(eligible, slot_position) * rating[channel_for_slot]); tiebreak by overall DESC then card_id ASC. Manager-first flow + first-vacant slot order unchanged from canonical autoDraft.

autoDraft._doc: Canonical first-card autoDraft — TELEMETRY ONLY. Production engine fixture (byte-stable for goldens); a measurement artifact when used as the realism population (see docs/investigations/engine-v2-asymmetric-realism-2026-06-07.md).

greedyOverallAutoDraft._doc: Position-blind max-overall NEGATIVE CONTROL. The gate ASSERTS this policy lands OUTSIDE every shape band, so nobody can 'fix' realism by maxing OVR — competent must mean slot-fit-aware, not max-overall.

shape_bands._doc: Tight Wilson bands around the strategicAutoDraft landings. Half-width = max(WilsonHalfWidthAroundObs at this N, variance_floor). The four shape norms are tracked together (each ±halfWidth around the strategic golden); goals/game is handled separately as a one-sided LOWER floor (no upper cap — total goal volume legitimately tracks the underdog gap).

goals_per_game_lower_floor._doc: One-sided LOWER floor. No upper cap because total goal volume legitimately rises with the strategic-underdog gap and there is no real-world ceiling. Floor = strategicAutoDraft observed minus ~2× Wilson half-width = honest-residual cushion below norm 2.54.

wilson_target_for_ko_metrics._doc: 95% Wilson half-width at N=2000 for KO-only metrics (KO→ET, shootout) is the chosen-N tooth criterion. With N=2000 strategicAutoDraft produces ~561 KO matches → ko_et half-width ≈ 3.89pp, shootout half-width ≈ 3.38pp — both ≤ ~4pp.
